description: Full-scale cinematic explosion — fireball, layered smoke, pressure-wave dust, and secondary debris. Designed for film/VFX hero shots.

orchestration_stages.label: Terrain Preparation
orchestration_stages.description: Prepare ground geometry for explosion interaction. Ground collision is required — explosion cannot float above terrain.

operations.name: terrain_geo
operations.notes: Use existing terrain if available. Otherwise create flat grid minimum 50m x 50m.

orchestration_stages.validation: Terrain geometry must exist at /obj/terrain_geo before proceeding.

orchestration_stages.label: Pyro Source Setup
orchestration_stages.description: Create the ignition volume that seeds the fireball simulation. Defines explosion scale and seed energy.
artistic_constraints: Ignition sphere radius 2–8m depending on explosion scale.
Source must emit temperature > 800 and density > 0.5 at ignition.

orchestration_stages.label: Fireball Core Simulation
orchestration_stages.description: Dense fireball — high temperature, luminance, expanding radius. Frames 1–30 peak.

operations.name: fireball_dop
operations.notes: DOP network for pyro fireball simulation.

orchestration_hints: Use pyro solver with buoyancy > 1.0 for upward expansion.
Temperature dissipation: slow — fireball must persist minimum 30 frames.
Combustion model: temperature-based.
Add turbulence noise at 3 frequency bands: 0.5, 1.0, 2.5 Hz.
artistic_constraints: Fireball must have 3 temperature zones: core (>1500), mid (500–1500), outer (<500).
No uniform sphere — turbulence must break the shape by frame 5.
Peak luminance at frame 8–15.

orchestration_stages.label: Smoke Evolution Layer
orchestration_stages.description: Billowing smoke rising from fireball — temperature cooling, turbulence, breakup variation at 3+ scales.
orchestration_hints: Continue pyro simulation — do not create new DOP for smoke.
Smoke appears when temperature drops below 300.
Add large-scale turbulence (wavelength 4–8m) for billow breakup.
Buoyancy decreases as temperature falls — smoke slows as it rises.
artistic_constraints: Smoke must have asymmetric breakup — add directional wind bias.
Three turbulence scales: micro (0.1m), mid (1m), macro (5m).
Dark at base (dense), lighter at top (sparse). Density gradient required.
No perfect symmetry at any stage.
Smoke must persist minimum 120 frames.

orchestration_stages.label: Pressure Wave Dust
orchestration_stages.description: Radial ground-level pressure/dust displacement wave. Fast early, slow decay.
artistic_constraints: Wave must hug ground — initial height maximum 2m.
Sharp leading edge — not diffuse from start.
Color must match terrain — sandy/earthy, not white.
Wave speed: 15–25m/s at onset, decaying.

orchestration_stages.label: Secondary Debris Field
orchestration_stages.description: Rigid-body debris launched from epicenter — rock, concrete, metal. Multiple scale categories.
orchestration_hints: Use voronoi fracture for debris generation.
RBD solver with collision against terrain.
Initial velocity: 8–20m/s outward, 3–10m/s upward.
Add angular velocity for tumbling.
artistic_constraints: Hero chunks: 0.3–2.0m — near camera.
Mid-scale: 0.05–0.3m — mid distance.
Fine particles: < 0.05m — far field.
All pieces must have tumbling rotation — no translation-only motion.
Closest pieces must be largest.

orchestration_stages.label: Cinematic Lighting
orchestration_stages.description: Set up cinematic lighting for the explosion shot. Required before render.
orchestration_hints: Use semantic workflow: arnold_cinematic_lighting.
Key light from explosion direction — warm orange-red.
Rim from opposite — cool blue/white.
Add volume scatter atmosphere.
artistic_constraints: Key-to-fill ratio minimum 4:1.
Volumetric atmosphere required.
Shadows must have penumbra.
Fireball must emit light that illuminates nearby ground.

orchestration_stages.label: Camera Framing
orchestration_stages.description: Set up camera with cinematic push-in and impact shake.
orchestration_hints: Use semantic workflow: cinematic_push_in.
Anticipation hold: minimum 12 frames before event.
Post-event: add impact shake via impact_handheld workflow.
Hero element must be readable throughout move.
artistic_constraints: Anticipation hold minimum 12 frames.
Push velocity must accelerate — not constant.
Final frame must have readable FX silhouette against sky.

orchestration_stages.label: Render Configuration
orchestration_stages.description: Configure Arnold render with AOVs, motion blur, volume sampling.
orchestration_hints: Use semantic workflow: arnold_render_ready.
Set up cinematic_aov_setup after render ROP.
Enable motion blur — volume and object.
Volume step size: 0.1m for preview, 0.02m for final.
artistic_constraints: AA samples: 4 preview, 8 final.
Motion blur must be ON.
All AOVs configured: beauty, emission, depth, cryptomatte.
Output format: EXR 16-bit or 32-bit.

review_expectations.fireball: Luminous, expanding, hot — not a flat sphere. Three temperature zones visible.
review_expectations.smoke: Asymmetric billowing — no uniform puffball. Scale variation visible.
review_expectations.pressure_wave: Visible at ground level. Sharp leading edge.
review_expectations.debris: Multiple scale categories. Tumbling rotation. Large near, small far.
review_expectations.lighting: Cinematic contrast. Volumetric depth. Fireball illuminates ground.
review_expectations.camera: Anticipation hold. Push-in with acceleration. Impact recoil.
review_expectations.render: Motion blur active. AOVs configured. EXR output.

orchestration_notes: Always decompose this workflow into stages. Never attempt full-scene generation in a single step. Minimum viable result requires stages 1–5 (through secondary_debris). Full cinematic result requires all 9 stages. For close-up hero shots, prioritize smoke_evolution quality over debris quantity.
